```{r}
library(Biobase)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
```


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
gcounts_raw <- read.csv(file.path("counts.txt"), sep = "\t", skip = 1)
gcounts <- gcounts_raw[,c(7:ncol(gcounts_raw))]
rownames(gcounts) <- gcounts_raw$Geneid

#Remove genes with 0 counts
gcounts <- gcounts[rowSums(gcounts) != 0,]

gcounts_colnames <- gsub("bam\\..+\\.(.+\\..+)_filtered\\.bam", "\\1", colnames(gcounts))
gcounts_colnames[c(223,224)] <- paste0("PAXgene.", gcounts_colnames[c(223,224)])
gcounts_colnames[c(225,226)] <- paste0("UHRR.", gcounts_colnames[c(223,224)])
gcounts_colnames <- gsub("\\.", "-", gcounts_colnames)
colnames(gcounts) <- gcounts_colnames
rownames(gcounts) <- gsub("(.+)\\.[0-9]+$", "\\1", rownames(gcounts))

write.csv(gcounts, "gcounts.csv")
```
